reference_claims.statement: The adopted snapshot identifies John of Lancaster as the duke of Bedford.
The snapshot records designation to keep England during Henry’s intended absence. It does not establish a current executable mandate.
The existing individual-control selection is eligible in this dated setup; eligibility is separate from received context and available handlers.

gaps.location: No adopted personal placement or nearby scene is established for this actor; do not infer Southampton from the expedition’s regional preparation.
gaps.received_information: The reference briefing and source bibliography are not receipts. Establish exactly which records this actor legitimately receives, including uncertainty/testimony status.
gaps.resources: Personal custody, inventory, balances, retinues and current readiness need individual evidence; unknown is not zero, and rank creates no account.
gaps.authority: A dated role reference does not prove current command, consent, obligations, access or resource permissions. Any operation must read actual Core authority.
gaps.operations: Engine must select and implement the bounded supported operation and source-backed context; Catalog prescribes no movement, NPC decision, resource grant or universal duration.
gaps.civil_time: Preserve the Julian 11 August source date at day precision with unknown hour. Resolve its initial presentation separately from elapsed spans; do not bind every action second to calendar time.

required_reviews.Engine: Publish versioned actor/mode readiness and reviewed initializer plus actual operation, received result and recovery; initialize new games only.
required_reviews.App: Review the selected actor and explicit supported/reference/declaration mode; show received context and separate civil/elapsed time without exposing private truth.
required_reviews.Catalog: Verify source references, actor/evaluator separation, independent positive/negative cases and actual owner results at exact commits.

forbidden_inferences: Fictional courier circumstances apply to John.
